selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is being asked from Allah in the first supplication?
questions.answer: That we be made among the people of happiness, safety, the Qur’an, and faith.

questions.question: Whose peace and blessings are being requested in the second supplication?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, along with his family and companions.

questions.question: How long does the prayer connect the recitation of the Qur’an across time?
questions.answer: From the beginning of its revelation until the end of time.

questions.question: What image is used to describe how Qur’anic words are carried when they are recited?
questions.answer: They are pictured as appearing in the movements of the air like reflections.

questions.question: Besides asking mercy for ourselves, who else is included in the du‘a?
questions.answer: Our parents and all believing men and women.

questions.question: What does the phrase at the end show about who deserves all praise?
questions.answer: All praise belongs to Allah alone, the Lord and Sustainer of every world.

questions.question: What does ending with praise to Allah add to the meaning of the whole passage?
questions.answer: It reminds us that every prayer should end with recognizing Allah’s greatness and giving Him thanks.

questions.question: Which attribute of Allah gives hope that these prayers can be accepted?
questions.answer: His vast mercy.

questions.question: What four qualities or groups does the first du‘a ask Allah to place us among?
questions.answer: Happiness, safety, the people of the Qur’an, and the people of faith.

questions.question: Upon whom are blessings and peace sent after that?
questions.answer: Upon Prophet Muhammad, his family, and his companions.

questions.question: What is unusually large about the number mentioned for these blessings?
questions.answer: It is tied to all the Qur’anic letters found in all its words as they are recited by all reciters through history.

questions.question: Which family members are directly remembered in the prayer for mercy?
questions.answer: One’s parents.

questions.question: Which larger group is also remembered for mercy?
questions.answer: All Muslim men and women.

questions.question: What name of Allah is used to ask for this mercy in a very hopeful way?
questions.answer: The One who is the most merciful of those who show mercy.

questions.question: What three groups are specifically included in the request for mercy?
questions.answer: Ourselves, our parents, and all believing men and women.

questions.question: In the opening line, what kind of people are we asking Allah to make us?
questions.answer: People who have true success, protection, attachment to the Qur’an, and faith.

questions.question: What is asked for the Prophet in addition to blessings?
questions.answer: Peace.

questions.question: Which people close to the Prophet are mentioned with him?
questions.answer: His family and his companions.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the recitation of Qur’anic words in the air?
questions.answer: It describes them as being shown through the moving air when the Qur’an is read.

questions.question: Who is reciting the Qur’an in this prayer’s description?
questions.answer: Every reciter of the Qur’an.

questions.question: Over what full span of history are those recitations counted?
questions.answer: From the first time the Qur’an was revealed until the end of the world.

questions.question: How does the passage close in a way that fits Islamic worship?
questions.answer: It ends by praising Allah as the Lord of all worlds.

questions.question: What is the first request made to Allah in the target passage?
questions.answer: That He place us among people of success, safety, the Qur’an, and faith.

questions.question: After that first request, what act of devotion is made for the Prophet?
questions.answer: Asking Allah to send peace and blessings upon him.
